ja: 今言えるのは、応急処置が効いているということだけです。
en: All I can say is that the workaround is holding.
alternatives: All I can tell you is that the workaround's holding.
I can only say that the workaround is holding up.
point: All I can say is that ～ で「言えるのは～だけ」

ja: 昨夜から復旧作業中ですが、まだ終わっていません。
en: We've been on it since last night but aren't done.
alternatives: We've been fixing it since last night and aren't finished.
We started last night and still aren't done.
point: 昨夜から続く作業は have been と since で表す

ja: 今は再起動しないでください。
en: Please don't restart it now.
alternatives: Don't restart it now, please.
Please don't restart it right now.
point: 否定の命令は Don't＋動詞の原形

ja: ネットワークの問題は除外しました。
en: We've ruled out a network issue.
alternatives: We ruled out the network as the cause.
A network issue has been ruled out.
point: 「除外する」は exclude より句動詞 rule out が自然

ja: 原因は多分設定変更ですが、断定はまだ早いです。
en: It's probably a config change, but too early to say.
alternatives: Probably the config change, though it's too soon to say.
I'd guess the config change, but I can't confirm yet.
point: 断定を避けるときは too early to say が定番

ja: 影響を受けたユーザーは何人ですか？
en: How many users are affected?
alternatives: How many users are impacted?
How many users has it affected?
point: How many の後は複数名詞 users、受け身は are affected

ja: 私たち、復旧を焦って確認を飛ばしました。
en: We rushed the fix and ended up skipping verification.
alternatives: In our rush to fix it, we skipped verification.
We were so rushed that we skipped verification.
point: end up の後ろは動名詞（ended up skipping）

ja: 落ちたサーバーは再起動済みです。
en: The server that crashed has been restarted.
alternatives: We've restarted the server that crashed.
The server that went down has been rebooted.
point: server を that 節で後ろから説明する

ja: 今回の障害は先月より長引いた。
en: This outage lasted longer than last month's.
alternatives: This outage took longer than last month's.
This outage was longer than last month's.
point: than の後ろは last month's のように名詞を省略できる

ja: ユーザーがまだログインできません。
en: Users still can't log in.
alternatives: Users are still unable to log in.
Users still can't sign in.
point: 「できない」は can't。still は can't の前に置く

ja: 影響範囲は、田中さんに今夜まとめてもらいます。
en: I'll have Tanaka summarize the impact tonight.
alternatives: I'll get Tanaka to summarize the impact tonight.
I'll ask Tanaka to write up the impact tonight.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: 本番前に、負荷テストをもっと回すべきだったね。
en: We should've run more load tests before launch.
alternatives: We should've done more load testing before launch.
Before launch, we should've run more load tests.
point: 過去の後悔は should have + 過去分詞（run はそのまま）

ja: 今、原因を調べています。
en: We're looking into the cause.
alternatives: We're investigating the cause now.
We're checking what caused it.
point: 「調べています」は進行形。look into で「調査する」

ja: 昨日のリリースを戻してもらえますか？
en: Could you roll back yesterday's release?
alternatives: Can you revert yesterday's release?
Would you mind rolling back yesterday's release?
point: 元に戻すは roll back。名詞なら back の前後どちらも可

ja: インフラ班は、決済は9時に戻ると言ってた。
en: Infra said payments would be back by 9.
alternatives: Infra told us payments would be restored by 9.
Infra said payments would be up again by 9.
Infra said payments would be back at 9.
point: said の後は will ではなく would にする

ja: 影響を受けるのは日本のユーザーだけ。
en: Only users in Japan are affected.
alternatives: This only affects users in Japan.
Just the users in Japan are affected.
point: 「影響を受けている」は are affected で表す

ja: 私たちがサービスを戻した途端、また落ちました。
en: We'd barely brought service back up when it went down again.
alternatives: As soon as we brought service back up, it went down again.
The moment we restored service, it went down again.
point: barely＋過去完了のあとに when で「〜した途端」を作る

ja: ユーザーに再ログインするよう伝えて。
en: Tell users to log in again.
alternatives: Tell the users to sign in again.
Tell users to log back in.
point: tell + 人 + to do。「人」は目的格で to の前に置く

ja: ログインエラーが出ています。
en: There's a login error.
alternatives: I'm getting a login error.
Login is showing an error.
point: エラー一つは There's a login error。a を忘れない

ja: 原因が分からないまま、私たちは夜通し対応しました。
en: Not knowing the cause, we worked through the night.
alternatives: We worked through the night without knowing the cause.
With the cause still unknown, we worked all night.
point: 理由を表す分詞構文は Not knowing のように否定を前に置く

ja: お客様が知りたいのは、影響範囲と復旧の見込みです。
en: What customers want to know is the impact and ETA.
alternatives: Customers want to know the impact and the ETA.
The impact and ETA are what customers want to know.
point: What 節が主語のときは動詞は is

ja: 金曜までに直してもらえますか？
en: Could you fix it by Friday?
alternatives: Can you fix it by Friday?
Could you have it fixed by Friday?
point: 丁寧な依頼は Could you。「までに」は by Friday

ja: 早く戻していれば、被害は小さく済んだのに。
en: If we'd reverted sooner, the damage would've been smaller.
alternatives: If we'd rolled back sooner, damage would've been smaller.
If we'd reverted sooner, the impact would've been smaller.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞、would have 過去分詞

ja: 決済 API 依存のサービスは今も不調です。
en: Services using the payment API are still down.
alternatives: Everything using the payment API is still failing.
Services relying on the payment API still fail.
point: 「〜を使う」は using で名詞の後ろから修飾

ja: 再発を防ぐため、アラートを追加しました。
en: We added alerts to prevent a recurrence.
alternatives: To prevent a repeat, we added alerts.
We added an alert so it won't recur.
point: 目的は to 不定詞。「再発防止」は prevent a recurrence

ja: 先ほど復旧しましたが、まだ調査中です。
en: Service came back earlier, but we're still investigating.
alternatives: Service was restored earlier, but we're still investigating.
It came back earlier, but we're still investigating.
point: 先ほどは過去形、今も続く調査は現在進行形

ja: 誰かがディスク警告に気づいてればよかった。
en: I wish someone had noticed the disk warning.
alternatives: If only someone had caught the disk warning.
I wish somebody had spotted the disk warning.
point: 過去への後悔なので wish の後は had noticed

ja: まずログを確認しましょう。
en: Let's check the logs first.
alternatives: First, let's check the logs.
Let's look at the logs first.
point: 提案は Let's＋動詞の原形。logs は複数形

ja: 閾値がもっと低ければ、早く気づけるのに。
en: If the threshold were lower, we'd notice sooner.
alternatives: We'd notice sooner if the threshold were lower.
If the threshold were lower, we'd catch it earlier.
point: 現在の仮定は If 節が were、主節は would + 動詞

ja: 不明なのは、なぜアラートが鳴らなかったかです。
en: What's unclear is why the alert didn't go off.
alternatives: We don't know why the alert didn't go off.
We can't tell why the alert never went off.
point: why の後は疑問文にせず、主語＋動詞の語順にする

ja: 昨夜サーバーが止まりました。
en: The server went down last night.
alternatives: Our server stopped working last night.
The server was down last night.
point: 「止まった」は went down。過去の出来事なので過去形
